source_analysis.contrast_policy: AA/AAA-first: body text 7:1 target, CTA text >= 4.5:1

contrast_report.wcag_note: Valores >= 4.5 son AA para texto normal; bg_text apunta a >= 7 cuando el palette lo permite.

design_system_injection.custom_css: :root { --bg: #0F172A; --surface: #162033; --surface-alt: #243044; --text: #F8FAFC; --muted: #CBD5E1; --primary: #F59E0B; --accent: #22C55E; --on-primary: #000000; --on-accent: #000000; --border: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 14%, transparent); --grid-line: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 8%, transparent); --radius: 40px; --gap: 48px; --blur: 18px; --nav-position: fixed; --shadow: 0 24px 70px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 13%, transparent); --shadow-strong: 0 36px 100px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 20%, transparent); } body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } h1,h2,h3,.display { font-family: 'Montserrat Alternates', sans-serif; } .blueprint { background-image: linear-gradient(var(--grid-line) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, var(--grid-line) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 48px 48px; } .spec-table { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); overflow: hidden; } .spec-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 180px 1fr; padding: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); } body::after { content: ''; position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; background-image: radial-gradient(color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 18%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 4px 4px; opacity: .035; z-index: 80; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .hero, .hero--bento, .local-map-panel, .editorial-flow { grid-template-columns: 1fr; min-height: auto; } .proof-strip { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }

services_grid.content_strategy: wide service track with alternating large cards
